propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome value types with provider-neutral contract specifying Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, DelaySource enums and serialization rules.
Implement singleton fake-clock retry budget owner enforcing maximum three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep with deterministic additive-jitter schedule.
Construct bounded diagnostics with six-key allowlist, message redaction via centralized seam, 512-code-point truncation, and eight-entry overflow sentinel.
After ambiguous writes, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered, failed observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown.
Canonical logical_id remains stable across all invocations; zero-based retry indexes produce [2s,3s) then [4s,5s) with no third sleep permitted.
Provider authoritative delays are lower bounds; over-budget delays return retry_not_before without incrementing counters or sleeping.
